report.summary: The alert is firing on a real, current breach of its condition: over the 5 minutes ending 2026-10-15T06:45:53Z the checkout PlaceOrder server-span series shows 3.75 error spans and 0 non-error (UNSET) spans, i.e. an observed error ratio of 1.0 (evidence 59f3c353-859b-409a-bd26-91edcef8684e-t0:f9cd66f8-9534-4f0c-a93f-25b91f989ad3, 59f3c353-859b-409a-bd26-91edcef8684e-t1:ef54838f-79fb-46cd-b9e2-887528f24506), which matches the alert's >0.5 condition and its '100%' annotation. The burst is only a few minutes old (error rate 0 up to the 06:40:54 evaluation, nonzero from 06:41:54), and it is localized to the checkout->payment charge step: the only error spans attributed to checkout in the hour are PlaceOrder (server, 3.05) and its outgoing oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge client span (3.05), while the payment service's own grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge server span recorded 5.08 errors versus 0 in the preceding hour. Trace error details show payment throwing an application error from /usr/src/app/charge.js:37 ('Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'), which checkout surfaces as gRPC status 2/13 and 500s through frontend, frontend-proxy and load-generator. The immediate mechanism of the firing is therefore well supported, but what makes payment reject charges is not established: the ~1–11 ms failures with no failing child span point to an in-process thrown error (consistent with a flag/injection-style fault, given the loyalty-level text and a single flagd ResolveFloat evaluation from payment in this hour), yet no flag value, configuration or change event was observed, and the observed flag-evaluation count (~1) is far below the failure count (>=5). The signal is also drawn from a very small denominator (~4 error spans in 5 minutes; ~6-7 PlaceOrder spans per 5 minutes typically) and had a similar unexplained excursion around 20:05-20:30 UTC on 2026-10-14.
